findings: THE INSTRUMENTS OF A TEXT ON A HYPOTHESIS. 'Features a critical Greek text, running text, multi-lingual translations (English, German, and French), parallel passages (Matthew, Luke, Mark, and the Gospel of Thomas), a concordance, and a history of Q research.' A critical edition establishes a text from its witnesses; here the witnesses are Matthew and Luke, and the edited text is the hypothesis's content. The composition reports the apparatus and is silent on what it is an apparatus of.
